generation.scope: For every finite Frobenius configuration, even nonreduced, a distinct singular opposite quadratic matrix always has adjugate the symmetric square of four independent cubics. All nonsquare quadratic adjugate factors are impossible, including two planes and the singular vertex of a rank-three cone. The proof bounds local kernel sections on branched covers and eliminates the constant-kernel quadratic contact by its ternary block.
